text:
incident-bot: Pager — SEV2: Cross-region routing anomaly detected between eu-west-1 <-> us-central-1. Elevated 502/5xx and request fanout spikes. Auto-paging oncall: @maria, @ken. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/cross-region-routing

maria: ack. I'm on it. seeing 502 spike at edge-proxy in eu-west at ~17:04 UTC, also a subset of requests routed to us-central where model endpoints are returning 503s.

ken: any recent routing policy deploys? @priya

priya: not from me. control-plane logs show a policy reconciliation at 17:02 that applied a stale pin set to a subset of eu-west prefixes. leader-election log shows leader change at 17:01. digging.

alex: can we do an emergency fallback to local-region steering for affected prefixes? propose: `redwood route override --prefix eu-west --mode fallback --reason "sev2"`

maria: initiating override now. running:
```
$ redwood route override --prefix eu-west --mode fallback --scope affected --wait
Override applied: id=ovr-3172 status=applied
```

incident-bot: config-change detected: route-controller v2.14 -> rollback trigger by @maria. Notifying router clusters: eu-west-edge-0..3

tom: customer impact: spikes causing errors for ~12% of EU traffic, targeted accounts: AcmeCorp, BetaLabs. Preparing incident customer notice.

priya: correlated cause: due to leader election, the pin controller wrote an older pin-set which had shorter TTL than edge cache expected; edge didn't dribble old pins fast enough and some requests overlapped with new steering rules, causing misroute -> 5xx from region mismatch.

ken: plan: 1) increase control-plane pin TTL to 300s 2) flush edge pin caches in eu-west and us-central 3) monitor 5xx.

alex: flushing edge caches now (eu-west first):
```
POST https://edge-admin.eu-west/flush-pins
{"scope":"all","confirm":true}
--> 202 Accepted
```

maria: flush complete on eu-west. metrics: 5xx rate down from 18% -> 6% in 4m. p95 latency from 450ms -> 210ms.

priya: bumping TTL and starting a staged drain in us-central.

maria: us-central flush done. 5xx now at 1.8% overall. continuing to watch. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-034, status=mitigated -> monitoring. Runbook appended: /playbooks/cross-region-pin-leader-race

priya: root cause notes: race in pin-controller leader election where on-leader-change reconciliation used stale cache snapshot. Immediate mitigation: TTL bump + forced cache flush. Long-term: fix reconciliation snapshot and add invariant check during leader change.

irwin: I'll pick up the PR to guard leader-change reconciliation tomorrow morning. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform for review.

eve: status page updated and customers notified. Sent targeted messages to AcmeCorp and BetaLabs.

ken: postmortem owners? priya (network-eng) for root cause, irwin for fix, maria for mitigation timeline, tom for customer comms.

maria: moving to post-incident bridge at 18:30 to go through timeline and next steps. closing on-call handoff to @ken now.

ken: thanks, taking handoff. will keep monitoring for 2 hours, escalate if error spikes >5%.

incident-bot: summary: mitigation applied (override + cache flush + TTL bump), customer impact reduced, follow-up PR and postmortem scheduled. :information_desk_person:
